blocks.x: Data & Lakehouse for Electronics & Semiconductors — trusted data at decision speed — pipelines, lakehouse and governance that stand up to audit applied to the electronics & semiconductors operating unit of Manufacturing & Industrial.

Semis and electronics fabrication run the tightest quality-latency loops in industry: yield analytics, tool matching and cleanroom reliability decided by telemetry at nanometer stakes. The fabs that win industrialize root-cause analytics and predictive tool health end to end.

items: Process telemetry, metrology and defect data siloed; excursion root-cause takes days of fab time.
Wafer-defect review by experts; rare classes unlearned.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Data Engineering & Pipeline Modernization, Lakehouse Architecture & Migration, Data Engineering & Pipeline Modernization from the Data, Analytics & Lakehouse tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Yield analytics/excursion RCA, Defect classification, Predictive tool maintenance) on Achala Forge and Achala Nexus. Governance inherits the sector frame — Export controls among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Decisions at event speed — sub-second pipelines from sensor, click or transaction to action.
Metrics into management — one governed semantic layer, decision cadence built in.
One customer, one product, one truth — MDM and catalog discipline that regulators can read.
